login.title: Admin Sign In
login.subtitle: Restricted area. Administrators only.
login.cardDescription: Enter your admin credentials to continue.

permissionDenied.title: Permission required
permissionDenied.description: You don't have permission to view this section. Ask a superadmin to grant access.

admins.title: Admin management
admins.subtitle: Create admins, assign permissions, and manage the superadmin tier.

delete.title: Delete admin account
delete.description: Permanently delete {{email}} and revoke all access? This cannot be undone.

promoteSuperadmin.title: Promote to superadmin
promoteSuperadmin.description: Grant {{email}} full superadmin access? They will implicitly hold every permission.

demoteToAdmin.title: Demote to admin
demoteToAdmin.description: Demote {{email}} back to a plain admin with no permissions?

transferRoot.title: Transfer root superadmin
transferRoot.description: Hand your root status to another superadmin. A verification code will be emailed to your address.
transferRoot.sentNote: We emailed a code to your address. Enter it below within 3 minutes.

admins.directPermissionsHint: Direct grants only. Permissions given through roles and permission sets are not counted: open the access panel to see them.

permissions.restricted: You don't have permission for this, so it's hidden and no request is sent.

shell.title: Administration
shell.forbiddenDescription: You are signed in, but this area requires an administrator role.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: High-level view of users and recent activity.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Search, filter, and manage every account.
users.empty: No users match the current filters.

userDetail.avatarDescription: Upload, replace, or remove this user's avatar.
userDetail.avatarUploadRestricted: You can't upload files, so the photo can't be replaced.
userDetail.removeAvatarDescription: This permanently deletes the photo from storage and clears the user's avatar. This cannot be undone.
userDetail.overviewDescription: Basic information and status for this user.
userDetail.activityDescription: Audit events recorded for this user.
userDetail.dangerDescription: These actions are audited and can't be undone by the target user.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Devices currently signed in to this account.

confirm.title: Terminate all sessions?
confirm.description: The user will be signed out of every device immediately and will need to log in again. This action is audited.

userDetail.adminTargetRestricted: Changing an admin account requires the admins:write permission, so this is hidden and no request is sent.

confirm.deleteDescription: This permanently removes the user and cannot be undone.
confirm.suspendDescription: The user loses access immediately and the account stays suspended until an admin lifts it.
confirm.unsuspendDescription: This re-enables the account and restores the user's access.
confirm.unlockDescription: This clears the failed sign-in counter and any temporary lock, so the user can sign in again right away.
confirm.changePasswordDescription: The user's password will be rotated to an unknown value. They must use the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page to regain access. You never see the new password.

files.title: Files
files.subtitle: Review, filter, and remove uploaded files.

filters.uploaderPlaceholder: Search by uploader name or email

files.empty: No files match the current filters.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this file?
confirmDelete.description: This permanently removes the file from storage. If it is a user's avatar, that avatar will be cleared. This cannot be undone.

activities.title: Activity log
activities.subtitle: Every audited event across the platform.
activities.empty: No activity matches the current filters.

audienceHint.user: For regular accounts: self-service permissions only.
audienceHint.admin: For admin panel accounts: any permission.

rbac.systemReadOnly: System elements cannot be changed or deleted.

fields.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores; dots separate parts. Fixed once created.
fields.name: Name

validation.keyInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: A role bundles permission sets and is assigned to accounts.
roles.noSetsAvailable: No permission set exists for this audience yet.

delete.title: Delete role
delete.description: Delete the role {{name}}? This cannot be undone.

sets.title: Permission sets
sets.subtitle: A permission set is a named group of permissions that roles include.

delete.title: Delete permission set
delete.description: Delete the permission set {{name}}? This cannot be undone.

access.title: Access
access.description: The roles, permission sets and permissions this account holds, and where each one comes from.
access.directHint: Direct permissions are edited in Admin management.
access.superadminNote: A superadmin holds every permission through its tier. Roles and permission sets cannot be assigned to it.
access.selfNote: You cannot change your own access.
access.forbiddenNote: Viewing the access of an admin account requires the admins:read permission.

assign.promoteWarning: Assigning an admin role or permission set gives this account access to the admin panel.
assign.listError: The list could not be loaded, so assignments cannot be changed now.
assign.demoteWarning: With no admin role, permission set or direct permission left, this account loses access to the admin panel and becomes a regular user.
assign.userRoleRequired: Keep at least one permanent user role.

rbac.genericError: The request failed. Check the values and try again.
rbac.catalogError: The permission list could not be loaded, so permissions cannot be edited now.
